## About
Magic Auto Enhancement, also known as MAE Upholstery, is an upholstery shop at 658 Griffith Road, Suite 113, in Charlotte. We take the time to make sure the job is done right, whether that's a torn seat cover or a full interior refresh.
Orlando does the work. Reviewers write about cracked arm rests patched, leather replaced, cushioning built back up and cracks fixed. We're rated 4.9 on Google from 253 reviews.
Besides cars, we also do commercial upholstery for restaurants, hotels, medical and gym settings around Charlotte.

## Services
- Custom Auto Upholstery: Upholstery done to fit your car and the look you want.
- Repair & Replacement: Worn or damaged upholstery, repaired or replaced.
- Seat leather and cushioning: Replacing the leather on a seat, increasing the cushioning and fixing cracks.
- Door upholstery: New upholstery on your door panels.
- Steering wheel and center console arm rest repair: Cracked center console arm rests and worn steering wheels brought back into shape.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call or send a request and we'll give you a free estimate on your service.

Q: Can I save on a service?
A: Yes. You can save 10% up to $100 on any service.

Q: What cars do you work on?
A: All makes and models.

Q: Can I come in outside your regular hours?
A: Call for an appointment. We'll work around your schedule.

Q: How long does a repair take?
A: It depends on the job. One reviewer said their repair was completed in a matter of hours.
